name: London's Aesop
source:
London's Aesop is a furry visual novel set in Britain's glorious capital.  Step into the shoes of Ethan Lockwood, a lonely young man with a heart full of secrets. A night out reveals the existence of another world and a meeting with Iroko, a hyena soldier on a mission.  Iroko is searching for the Aesops, a wide array of tools that grant incredible powers.  Now the two must work to gather them before they turn London inside-out. 

Every choice made matters: Will Ethan and Iroko become friends? Inseparable companions? Maybe something more? Even a single misstep could lead to a cruel fate. Face the past you left behind, uncover the mystery of the Aesops, and try not to lose your mind. 

[From [url=https://hyenadev.itch.io/londons-aesop]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
伦敦的《伊索》是一部以英国辉煌首都为背景的毛茸茸视觉小说。扮演伊森·洛克伍德（Ethan Lockwood），一个内心充满秘密的孤独年轻人。一次外出的夜晚揭示了另一个世界的存在，并与正在执行任务的鬣狗士兵伊洛科 (Iroko) 会面。Iroko正在寻找伊索，这是一系列可以赋予不可思议力量的工具。现在，两人必须努力在伦敦被彻底颠覆之前将他们聚集起来。

每个选择都很重要：伊森和绿子会成为朋友吗？形影不离的同伴？也许还有更多？即使一个失误，也可能导致残酷的命运。面对你留下的过去，揭开伊索之谜，尽量不要失去理智。

[来自[url=https://hyenadev.itch.io/londons-aesop]Itch.io[/url]]
